question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Hamper
solution:
The correct answer is **"Promote."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Hamper"** means to hinder or impede progress or movement. (अवरुद्घ होना, रुकना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The building work was **hampered**__ by bad weather.*
 
 
 
• **"Promote"** means to support or encourage the growth or development of something. (किसी बात को प्रोत्‍साहित करना; किसी बात के होने या बढ़ने में सहायता करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *We need to **promote**__ her activities.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the antonym of** hamper** is **promote**.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Obscure** means to make unclear or difficult to understand. (किसी वस्‍तु या प्रसंग को धुँधला या दुर्बोध बना देना)
 
• **Reduce** means to make smaller in size or quantity. (मात्रा, क़ीमत, आकार आदि की दृष्टि से घटाना; छोटा करना)
 
• **Hinder **means to make it difficult for something to happen or progress. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के लिए कठिनाई पैदा करना, किसी के काम में बाधा डालना)
